text:
Situation: Etomidate 2 mg/mL 10 mL vials are in shortage. FDA first posted the shortage on 2022-10-05 and it remains Current as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 7.6 days on hand across three lots (83, 44, and 48 vials). Corvale General holds 17 days on hand across three lots (200, 115, and 85 vials). Corvale Lakeside holds 24.3 and 20 days on hand (52 and 40 vials).

Why (FDA record): The Hospira, Inc. plant (FEI 1021343) was classified VAI on 2019-11-21, 1,049 days before the shortage posting. The Hikma Farmaceutica (Portugal) S.A. plant (FEI 3002807173) was classified VAI on 2020-03-06, 943 days before the shortage posting. Both plants received subsequent VAI classifications after the shortage posting, on 2023-02-03 and 2023-04-21.

Our position: Internal transfer is the fastest way to protect Corvale East without new procurement. Alternate manufacturers are approved and listed as Current by FDA.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 70 vials of etomidate 2 mg/mL 10 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by Pharmacy Director.
2. Activate Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. etomidate 2 mg/mL as alternate manufacturer — approved by pharmacist verification.
3. Activate Civica, Inc. etomidate 2 mg/mL as alternate manufacturer — approved by pharmacist verification.

Not recommended: Delay transfer pending new purchase orders; rely solely on Corvale Lakeside stock without a redistribution plan.
